title: Vector range with arithmetic (W-1 downto 0) where W is a constant
license: internal regression test, no external reference
problemDescription: Signal declared with `std_logic_vector(W-1 downto 0)` where `W` is a local constant. After SourceElaborator's generic substitution, P4 ends up with `std_logic_vector(16-1 downto 0)` — Kmila's array-bound parser only handles literal ints. Fix: pre-evaluate arithmetic expressions in vector range bounds.
